about_the_game:
GrowBud - your bud-growing buddy that keeps you company while you work or play. Grow and master 30+ authentic cannabis strains while progressing through clubs, unlocking equipment, and building your ultimate strain collection.

Strain Discovery & Mastery

Discover 30+ authentic cannabis strains, each with unique growing requirements. Grow plants from seed to harvest, then trim them back to start again. Level up individual strains and master their characteristics to produce perfect 6-star buds.

Club Progression

Progress through The Grow Club, led by Sage, to become a master grower (knowledge & craft) and The Bud Club, with Blaze, to become a master designer (efficiency & yield). Complete challenges from both paths simultaneously to unlock exclusive strains, genetics and equipment. Progress through 5 levels in each club to become a master cultivator.

Orders

Grow your buds and complete orders for the local dispensary, premium buyers, and rush orders to earn gold, new strains and other rewards.

Gene Expressions

Use genetic modifiers to tune strain characteristics, enhance growth, and unlock different playstyles - full automation for hands-off growing, productivity bonuses for focused work, or active management for detailed control.

Collection

Gotta grow 'em all! Discover, grow, and master all 30+ strains, earning the coveted Golden Status. Gaze upon your collection in beautiful jar displays in the strain library.

Grow House Customisation

Upgrade your growing spaces with better lighting, equipment, and decorations. Advanced gear helps tackle the challenges of higher-level strains and improves your overall efficiency.

Desktop Companion Features

Sits comfortably beside your work with multi-monitor support, always-on-top mode, and flexible positioning. Grow cannabis while you focus on other tasks.

-----

Mature Content

Simulates cannabis cultivation for educational purposes. Designed for adult audiences.

content_descriptors.notes:
GrowBud is a cannabis cultivation simulation designed for adult audiences. Players grow virtual cannabis plants while learning about authentic strain genetics, growing techniques, and plant biology. The game presents cannabis cultivation from an educational and horticultural perspective.

The game includes:
- Simulation of cannabis plant cultivation from seed to harvest
- Educational information about real cannabis strain characteristics
- References to therapeutic applications of CBD strains within gameplay challenges
- Economic simulation involving the sale of harvested virtual crops

No explicit drug use is depicted or encouraged. The game focuses on the agricultural and scientific aspects of plant cultivation rather than consumption. All content is presented within an educational simulation framework appropriate for adult audiences interested in horticulture and plant biology.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Apple M1 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible graphics with 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 / Apple M1 Pro or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible graphics with 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

name: GrowBud

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1909 or higher)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible with 1GB VRAM (GTX 750 Ti / RX 560 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible with 2GB VRAM (GTX 1060 / RX 580 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
